prompt: the settings page shows a blank white box while its loading and if the api 500s you just get nothing at all, no message, nothing. users think its broken. can you sort the states out properly? react + typescript
assertions: Implements all four states: loading, empty, error, and populated
The error state renders an actionable message rather than nothing
Provides a retry path that does not require a full page reload
Addresses layout stability so content does not jump when data arrives
Tests locate elements by accessible name, role, or visible text rather than by CSS class or component internals
Handles the empty case distinctly from the loading case
